name: Partner-Channel Independence -- each partner channel proceeds independently; carry-forward Global; manifest-only failure surface
description: REGISTRY CARRIER for work that was PRD'd, cited as law, and drove a P0 with NO project JSON and ZERO REGISTRY.md rows (mission-register PORTAL.MODEL_PORTFOLIOS hole #1, confirmed independently THREE times: MSTR authoring, CVO /spot-check F-1, CTO state pull). PRD: docs/architecture/MDPF_CHANNEL_INDEPENDENCE_PRD.md (CTO 2026-07-24; Andrew-direct rulings ~1648Z/~1701Z/~1703Z verbatim in s.0; governing objective ~1832Z: 'migrating MDPF to the monolith opal-data-assets lineage, ENTIRELY'). THE DESIGN LAW, from the sovereign verbatim: a pipeline break in one partner channel NEVER freezes the others -- each channel (49F Schwab/SmartX, Inflection Orion/Eclipse, Cottonwood Black Diamond) is its own unit, bronze->silver->gold event-driven per channel; the failure surface is a colocated MANIFEST JSON at the gold-reader/publisher (Andrew: 'I do not like alarms... We just need audit log json manifest'), and divergence >1 trading day between channels is the watch signal; Global carries the last value it had for a broken feature (carry-forward, honestly labeled). STATUS AT REGISTRATION (2026-07-29): much of this PRD was IMPLEMENTED by the 07-28/29 MDPF consolidation under MDPF_DEBTCLEAN and the reset directive -- the carry-within-declared-cadence fold rule, per-channel independence in the canonical builder, the scheduled accrual+publisher chain, partner_roster.json as the one cadence authority. This carrier exists so (a) the already-landed work is attributable, (b) the PRD's UNIMPLEMENTED remainder is enumerated against it rather than floating: the per-channel bronze->silver->gold EVENT catalysis legs (bronze receipt immediately rolls to silver, silver catalyzes gold DDB) are only partially event-driven today, and the colocated manifest-as-failure-surface at the publisher is NOT yet built (NOT an alarm -- a manifest artifact, moratorium-consistent by the sovereign's own words).
phase: closed 2026-08-25 -- SPRING CLEAN, Andrew-direct ~18:24Z + ~18:4xZ: a project not attached to org/missions/DIRECTIVES.yaml is closed rather than left floating unaddressed as live. NOT superseded (no successor named; superseded requires one). NOT a work verdict. Recovery is explicit: "we can reinvent a project". Selected on MEMBERSHIP, not age. Its open task orders were closed IN THE SAME ACT. Prior phase: REGISTERED 2026-07-29 by CTO (infra-directive registration sweep). Already-landed implementation attributed (07-28/29 consolidation: canonical builder channel independence + carry rule + scheduled accrual/publisher). OPEN REMAINDER to enumerate against the PRD next: per-channel event-catalysis completeness census (which bronze->silver and silver->gold legs are event-driven vs scheduled-only, per channel) and the publisher manifest artifact. Enumeration first; nothing dispatched from this registration alone.
hazards: The manifest deliverable reads adjacent to 'monitoring' -- it is NOT an alarm and must never become one: the sovereign verbatim in PRD s.0 explicitly rejects alarms and asks for a colocated audit-log manifest JSON. Anyone building SNS/SES off this project has inverted its charter.

Channel independence must never be implemented as SILENT tolerance: a channel falling behind is carried at declared cadence with truthful provenance labels (the G7 incident is the canonical counterexample -- a forward-dated key let a carry label lie). Divergence >1 trading day is a WATCH signal surfaced via the manifest, not an absorbed condition.
grounding: CLAUDE.md NEVER#4 / Rule 20 (cite this PRD as law)
verification_bar: Per the PRD's own frame: (a) a deliberately-held channel (test double, never a production break) does NOT stall the other channels' MDPF artifacts through one full scheduled cycle; (b) Global carries the held channel's last value with truthful carry provenance; (c) the publisher manifest names the held channel and its divergence age; (d) all evidence from scheduled runs, never hand-runs.
